name: YD Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Based in China, YiDong Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the innovation, production, and marketing of high-precision electronic components. The company's diverse product range includes flexible printed circuit (FPC) boards, various connector solutions, and LED backlight modules. Their specific offerings encompass meticulously engineered stamping components, electrical terminals, and structural frames. Within its connector segment, the company provides optical communication parts, precision structural elements, and LCD connectors, in addition to manufacturing molds. These advanced components are integral to a broad spectrum of industries, such as personal electronics, telecommunications, sustainable energy, vehicle manufacturing, industrial applications, and medical technology. Established in 1997, the company maintains its headquarters in Dongguan, China.
